title: 第一卷 第1章 刚来就让我走？
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

徐北军区2号大院外。

秋风瑟瑟。

深秋的风已经带着冬天的寒气，透薄的衣衫已经捂不住热气，季望棉抱臂摩裟着肩膀，想要给自己增加一些热量，此时她的嘴唇已经被冻得毫无血色。

站岗的黑兵哥站得笔直，可是余光时不时地扫过季望棉。

此时季望棉穿着带补丁的夏衫，灰扑扑的颜色很普通，平时在人群里十个有九个都是这样的黑灰色，

奈何衣服的主人实在美丽。

眉如远山含黛，天然弯翘，眼瞳清潋似水，眼尾微微上挑，自带勾人风韵，还有一身晃眼的嫩白。

季望棉抬头看去。

四目相对。

黑兵哥只觉得一股电流酥酥麻麻地传遍全身，脸瞬间黑红黑红的，慌乱地躲避，假装自己认真站岗。

季望棉抿了抿唇。

好久没见过这么纯情的人了。

她已经习惯了这种关注，倒是站在身侧的中年男人狠狠瞪了对方一眼，低声。

“棉棉，你可别糊涂，一个新兵蛋子可不值得你勾搭，你最好给我安分点，要是坏了我的事，回去我就把你嫁到山上去。”

季望棉低着头没有说话，但是柔弱的姿态表示她的服从。

男人见状，叹了一口气，语重心长道：“棉棉，别怪大伯，你这张脸在乡下就是浪费，大伯养了你那么多年，可不舍得你在乡下吃苦，你就该嫁给吃饷的，你要是冷，就去，就去。”

季大珠看了看四周：“看到没，那个大树，背风，你先去站站，可别冻流鼻涕了，难看。”

这该死的秋天，怎么能这么冷！

“好的，大伯！”

季望棉听话地朝着树旁走去，季大珠看着侄女单薄怯懦的背影，叹了口气。

他也不想，但是谁想一辈子在地里当老黄牛呢！

有点门路的不是去城里当工人，就是去当兵了，就等着改换门庭。

父母早亡，他真是一把屎一把尿地养大了弟弟季二珠。

以前季二珠叫季二猪，猪是季大珠见过最贵重的东西了。

可是随着季二猪长大，发现自己跟哥哥的名字不一样，不像一家人。

哭着闹着要改，没办法，改成了季二珠。

给他娶妻生子，本来以为能松口气，结果两口子一点心不操，生了四个孩子了，到现在两眼一睁就等他安排。

这么大年纪了，戳一棍子两口子动一下，真是没眼看！

没办法，作为全家希望。

他一个人拼了命钻营，在村里当牛做马，也就止步村支书，再也没办法往上了，每天愁得睡不着觉。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Outside the No. 2 compound of Xubei Military Region.

The autumn wind rustled.

The late autumn wind was already carrying the chill of winter, and the thin clothes could no longer contain the heat. Ji Wangmian crossed her arms and rubbed her shoulders, trying to add some heat to herself. At this time, her lips were already bloodless from the cold.

The black soldier on guard stood straight, but his peripheral vision glanced at Ji Wangmian from time to time.

At this time, Ji Wangmian was wearing a patched summer shirt. The gray color was very ordinary. Nine out of ten people in the crowd usually wore this black and gray color.

However, the owner of the clothes is really beautiful.

Her eyebrows are as dark as a distant mountain, naturally curved, her pupils are as clear as water, and the ends of her eyes are slightly raised, giving her a charming charm and a dazzling white skin.

Ji Wangmian looked up.

Eyes facing each other.

Brother Hei Bing only felt a tingling electric current spread throughout his body. His face instantly turned black and red. He fled in a panic, pretending to be on guard seriously.

Ji Wangmian pursed his lips.

I haven't seen such an innocent person in a long time.

She was used to this kind of attention, but the middle-aged man standing next to her gave her a fierce look and whispered.

"Mianmian, don't be confused. A new recruit is not worth hooking up with. You'd better stay calm with me. If you ruin my affairs, I will marry you to the mountains when you get back."

Ji Wangmian lowered her head and said nothing, but her weak posture showed her submission.

Seeing this, the man sighed and said seriously: "Mianmian, don't blame uncle, your face is a waste in the country. Uncle has raised you for so many years, but he is not willing to let you suffer in the country. You should marry a wage earner. If you are cold, go, go."

Ji Dazhu looked around: "Did you see that big tree with the wind behind it? Go and stand first. Don't get cold and runny nose. It's ugly."

How can it be so cold in this damn autumn!

"Okay, uncle!"

Ji Wangmian walked obediently towards the tree. Ji Dazhu looked at his niece's weak and timid back and sighed.

He doesn't want to either, but who wants to be a scalper in the fields all their life?

Those with some connections either went to work as workers in the city or as soldiers, waiting to change careers.

His parents died young, so he raised his younger brother Ji Erzhu like shit.

In the past, Ji Erzhu was called Ji Erzhu, and pigs were the most precious things Ji Dazhu had ever seen.

But as Ji Erzhu grew up, he found that he and his brother had different names, and they didn't look like a family.

I cried and clamored to change it, but had no choice but to change it to Ji Erzhu.

They originally thought they would be relieved to get him a wife and have children, but the couple didn't worry about it at all. They gave birth to four children, and now they are waiting for him to make arrangements as soon as they open their eyes.

At such an old age, it's really hard to see if you poke a stick and move it twice!

There is no way, as the whole family hopes.

He worked hard on his own and worked as a cow or horse in the village. He was no longer the village party secretary and could no longer move up. He was so worried that he couldn't sleep every day.
